description: Checks if files are formatted and returns a structured list of files needing formatting.

cache.description: Cache formatted files for faster subsequent checks (maps to --cache)

config.description: Path to a Prettier configuration file (maps to --config)

ignorePath.description: Path to a custom ignore file (maps to --ignore-path)

ignoreUnknown.description: Ignore files that cannot be parsed (maps to --ignore-unknown)

logLevel.description: Log level to control output verbosity

noConfig.description: Do not look for a configuration file (maps to --no-config)

parser.description: Force a specific parser for ambiguous file types (maps to --parser)

printWidth.description: The line length where Prettier will try to wrap

singleQuote.description: Use single quotes instead of double quotes where possible

tabWidth.description: Number of spaces per indentation level (maps to --tab-width)

name: format-check
title: Prettier Check
